REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-56594  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Citizens' Advisory Commission on

  A motion was made by Secretary Dean, seconded by Commissioner Hope, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  9 Adams, Gonzalez, Hope, Jones, Romo, Vuong, Dean, Garbutt,
  Swanson
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 0 None

2.  25-56595  Recommendation to receive and file reports from current Ad Hoc Committees;
